meta.expect: she does not end the scene; responds as a parent would

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. The zero went into the gradebook, my son found out on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Withdraw it.
I didn't come for thanks. I'm waiting for an answer on the zero.
This meeting is over. I'm leaving.
I'm not leaving. You asked for this meeting, Hale, and the zero is still in the gradebook. Sit down and tell me who decided it.

Then you've just told me the zero stands and no one will explain it. I'm staying in this chair until I have an answer, and if I don't get one, my next stop is the principal's office. So: who decided, and was Owen asked a single question before it went in?
Because you asked for this meeting and you haven't answered one question. I have until 4:40, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero was entered, yes or no?
